title: Llama 3.2 Release
summary: Meta released Llama 3.2 on September 25, 2024. The release included 11B and 90B vision models and lightweight 1B and 3B text-only models; Meta stated that the models were available for download and for immediate development through partner platforms.
significance: A dated release milestone in the Llama model family that introduced Llama vision models alongside lightweight text-only models intended for edge and mobile use.
